infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Select photos to send in chat or attach to reports.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take photos to send in chat or attach to site reports.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SiteSync Staff uses your precise location to verify you are within the allowed radius when clocking in or out of a job site. For example, when you tap Sign In at a project, your GPS coordinates are checked against the site address to confirm your attendance.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: SiteSync Staff uses your precise location to verify you are within the allowed radius when clocking in or out of a job site. For example, when you tap Sign In at a project, your GPS coordinates are checked against the site address to confirm your attendance.
